# biznetgio_baremetal (Resource)

NEO Metal bare-metal server. Order instance, atur label, power state, reset, dan rebuild OS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Auth: set BIZNETGIO_API_KEY (dan optional BIZNETGIO_BASE_URL) di env var.

data "biznetgio_baremetal_products" "all" {}

resource "biznetgio_baremetal_keypair" "main" {
  name = "neo-metal-key"
}

resource "biznetgio_baremetal" "main" {
  product_id = data.biznetgio_baremetal_products.all.products[0].product_id
  cycle      = "m"
  select_os  = "ubuntu-22"
  keypair_id = biznetgio_baremetal_keypair.main.keypair_id
  label      = "neo-metal-main"
  public_ip  = 1

  # power_state = "on"   # ganti ke "off" buat stop
  # reset_trigger = ""   # ganti nilainya buat reboot sekali
  # rebuild_os = "centos7-base"  # ganti buat wipe & reinstall OS
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cycle` (String) Siklus billing, misal `m` (monthly) atau `a` (annual).
- `keypair_id` (Number) Id keypair dari `biznetgio_baremetal_keypair`. Keypair pool baremetal terpisah dari neolite/gpu.
- `label` (String) Nama tampilan server. Satu-satunya field yang bisa diupdate via `PUT /baremetals/{account_id}`.
- `product_id` (Number) Product id dari data source `biznetgio_baremetal_products` atau portal.

### Optional

- `pay_with_credit_card` (Boolean) Bayar invoice pake kartu kredit saat order. Default true (auto-charge). Set false kalau mau ninggalin invoice unpaid di portal — resource bakal stuck Pending sampai dibayar.
- `power_state` (String) Power state server: `on` atau `off`. Update hanya mengirim `PUT .../state/{state}` kalau nilainya berubah.
- `promocode` (String) Kode promo.
- `public_ip` (Number) Jumlah public ip yang diminta (1 = dengan public ip). Enum `Public_IP_options`.
- `rebuild_os` (String) Kalau berubah, instance di-rebuild (wipe OS) pake `PUT /baremetals/{account_id}/rebuild`. List OS valid ada di data source `biznetgio_baremetal_rebuild_os_list`.
- `reset_trigger` (String) Trigger one-shot reset/reboot: ganti nilainya buat re-trigger. Reset cuma aksi, bukan state stabil.
- `select_os` (String) OS yang dipasang saat create, dari `GET /baremetals/products/{product_id}/oss`. Default `ubuntu-22`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (Number) Account id baremetal di BiznetGIO.
- `created_at` (String) Tanggal dibuat (alias created_at/date_created).
- `id` (String) Resource id = account_id dari BiznetGIO.
- `ip_address` (String) Public ip address server kalau ada di response.
- `order_id` (String) Order id dari response create.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response terakhir dari API, buat akses field yang belum dimodel.
- `status` (String) Status terakhir dari API (misal Active, Pending, Suspended, Terminated).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
